scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Cayley sums of coordinate boxes and nonnegative, no-zero-row matrices. Combinatorial results depend on matrix support, while the integral smoothness test also depends on singleton lengths. The explicit small-case checker does not establish the all-dimensional assertion; that is proved via tangent cones. General priority beyond inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: The one-skeleton and sharp smoothness boundary of Cayley box polytopes
